title: Probability Update Log
purpose: Version probability changes so the site can show what changed, when it changed, and why.
rules: Every probability change needs a reason.
Every reason should reference a signal, record, source route, or verified card.
Forecasts can move up, move down, be confirmed, or be rejected.
Old probabilities stay visible for accountability.

entries.change: Probability Lab created with four seed scenarios.

Add weighted scenario-impact signals from source routes, preliminary VRCs, intake queue and systems category map.
